Definition

The base blockchain layer responsible for the final and irreversible recording of transactions and asset transfers, providing security and trust for portfolio custody and clearing.

Operational example

Portfolio transactions rely on the settlement layer for secure and irreversible recording, ensuring finality and auditability of digital asset movements.
